summary: Used the global best length as the current streak counter, causing separate consecutive runs to be accumulated together.
trigger: When computing a maximum across multiple candidates, distinguish the current candidate measurement from the best measurement seen so far.
corrected_rule: Reset a current streak length for every valid sequence start, then update the global maximum after measuring that sequence.
repair_prompt: Explain which two counters are needed to compare several independent consecutive-value runs and when each should be reset or updated.
